why_this_is_a_rollforward_not_a_fresh_re.reason: v0.1.3 QA Closure Sections A-H (this section included) must complete offline, before Sections I/J execute one authorized real NVDA smoke test and the fresh six-ticker v0.1.3 production run set. No fresh v0.1.3 run data exists yet at the time this artifact was produced, so 'healthy semantic runs' still means the same Step 5A six-ticker coverage-validation runs (outputs/runs/_step5a_coverage_{nvda,qqq,msft,sndk,tsm,amd}) that docs/audit_artifacts/high_value_unclassified_recovery_report.json (v0.1.2.1) already reviewed exhaustively.
why_this_is_a_rollforward_not_a_fresh_re.why_the_prior_conclusions_still_hold_unc: This v0.1.3 session's own code changes (Section B: entity-exposure seed-status API overlay; Section C: alpha_level_classifier.py Active-level gate; Section D: conflict_detector.py bull_structure/bear_structure display filter) touch B4 qualification, the Conflict Detector, and Entity Exposure -- all stages strictly DOWNSTREAM of Alpha Mapper matching. None of them re-runs or re-scores match_status/candidate_scores/no_match classification for any claim. The 2091 MATCHED / 2764 NONE / 39 UNAVAILABLE split, and the 209-candidate reviewed pool and its per-item CORRECT_NONE/DUPLICATE_OR_LOW_VALUE/STRONG/BORDERLINE verdicts, are therefore byte-identical to v0.1.2.1's finding if re-run against this same source data today -- re-doing the full manual semantic re-adjudication would reproduce the same 209 rows with the same conclusions, not surface anything new.
why_this_is_a_rollforward_not_a_fresh_re.what_could_change_this_on_the_fresh_v0.1: A pre-existing (session-predating), unrelated repair already staged in comqutor_alpha/structure_engine/alpha_mapper.py -- ALPHA_CLASSIFIER_BATCH_SIZE reduced 40 -> 15, plus bounded ThreadPoolExecutor concurrency in week2_llm.py -- fixes the WEEK2_LLM_TIMEOUT starvation that caused some of the 39 UNAVAILABLE rows in the Step 5A run. A fresh v0.1.3 run under this repair could plausibly convert some prior UNAVAILABLE rows into a real MATCHED or NONE verdict, changing the NONE pool's composition. This report must be regenerated against the actual fresh v0.1.3 six-ticker run set once Section J completes -- carried forward as an explicit action item, not silently dropped.
